capabilities: Choose which notes and which tags to process
Configure AI model, parameters, and tag descriptions in settings
View, cancel, and delete persistent tagging operations
extras: README warns that more reasoning steps significantly increase token cost and tagging time, and that reasoning steps must keep the {description} and {tag} placeholders. Notes that a third-party service is required unless the AI model is self-hosted. The manifest states the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to apply tags automatically with an AI model, so tagging many notes by hand is slow.
